item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 14/Jul/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring extremely hot and generally fine weather to southern China today and tomorrow. The broad area of low pressure now over the vicinity of Luzon is expected to move across the northern part of the South China Sea during the weekend and early next week. It may develop into a tropical cyclone, and move in the general direction of the vicinity of the coast of western Guangdong to Hainan Island. The weather will be windy with squally showers and thunderstorms over the coast of southern China and there will be swells.

Date/Month: 14/07 (Friday)
Wind: Light winds force 2.
Weather: Mainly fine apart from isolated showers. Extremely hot during the day.
Temp range: 29 - 35 C
R.H. range: 55 - 90 per Cent
